title: I intend to make a collection of your sayings if you will let me.
html_source: Haines is collecting Irish folk songs and esoterica, similar to how colonialists adopt culture from “backwater” countries as modernity begins to take over. In this way, and his learning of Gaelic, Haines can be seen as a cultural appropriator of Irish.
